image_description: A close-up portrait of a person wearing a voluminous, messy blonde wig that obscures most of their face. The wig features tangled, wind-blown strands with a mix of straight and wavy textures. Sunglasses are visible beneath the hair, along with partial views of the subject's nose, mouth, and chin. The background is a plain, light-colored wall.
